prompt: Create one high fidelity native Android app UI design concept, portrait 432x960 screen, flat straight-on screen artwork with no phone hardware, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. MenetrendGO, a Hungarian MÁV timetable and vehicle tracking app. Operate mode, effortlessly clear commuter tool. User-pinned aesthetic: fully rounded, slightly liquid-glassed, quiet cool pale icy blue background #EDF4FA, deeply legible midnight blue #112D43, restrained royal blue #2864D9 action, broad generous whitespace, subtle translucent blue-white panels with luminous upper edges and gentle offset soft shadows, never heavy blur or shiny toy chrome. Native Material 3 anatomy, Roboto, accessible readable type, 48dp controls, coherent thin rounded outline icons. Status bar 9:41. Four labeled bottom navigation destinations exactly: Tervezés, Térkép, Bérletek, Beállítások, Tervezés selected; rounded floating translucent navigation with system gesture bar below. Header MenetrendGO and small profile-free notification bell. Exact Hungarian typography as far as possible. Clear primary action 'Járatok keresése'. Fields 'Honnan?' and 'Hová?' have selected values 'Mór, autóbusz-állomás' and 'Székesfehérvár'. A swap icon button beside fields; date/time control 'Ma, indulás most'. Below form show sample route 20:15 → 21:01, 46 perc, Közvetlen, bus route 8097, a small pass chip 'Bérlet: ellenőrzés szükséges'. Label sample results 'Szemléltető adatok' subtly but legibly. No prices, no official logo, no advertisements, no invented features, no English UI labels. Show entire usable app screen at sharp resolution. Layout A search-first: The screen title 'Hová indulunk?' is large but native 28sp. Upper half a single floating milky glass journey form with two generous vertically stacked station rows, route swap along right edge, date/time below, then full width rounded blue search button. Lower half one upcoming journey preview and small 'Legutóbbi keresés' row. Strong calm hierarchy, search owns attention.
approval: User chose search-first plus recents; results must open a separate long-list page; fully rounded UI.
